dedupe_keys.name: vorbehaltsgebiet fur die errichtung von windenergieanlagen

description: Vorbehaltsgebiet für die Errichtung von Windenergieanlagen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Reserved areas are areas in which a technical concern (here: Wind power) should be given particular weight when weighing up with competing uses. In the regional plans, the Regional Planning Associations can define areas of reservation for the construction of wind turbines within the framework of regional governance concepts. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Reserve area for the construction of wind turbines" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vorbehaltsgebiet, Regionalplanung, Regionalplan, Windenergie, gdiby, Wind. The listing shows 2015-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
